playstyle.identity: Yunara is a marksman who deals sustained damage from the bot lane. She excels at kiting and dealing consistent damage in extended fights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Focus on farming and scaling. Position safely in teamfights and deal consistent damage while kiting back from threats. Use abilities to enhance your auto attacks and maintain distance from enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yunara spikes with her core marksman items. Kraken Slayer and crit items scale her damage. She's strongest in the mid to late game when fully itemized.
